📺 50-inch TV

The shop says "50-inch TV". You measure it: 40 inches wide, 30 inches tall.

Where is the 50 inches?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

TVs are measured

across the diagonal

Step 2

30² + 40² = 2500

√2500 = 50

Corner to corner! Pythagoras sells TVs. 📺

🏠 Menu

🔑 Finding a shorter side

Ask first, then click for each one.

🔍 Spot it

Is the missing side the ?

HYPOTENUSE or a short side

➖ Short side

Short side² = ?

hypotenuse² − other side²

⚠️ Check

A short side must be ?

SHORTER than the hypotenuse

🪜 Ladders

A leaning ladder is the ?

HYPOTENUSE

Long side missing: add. Short side missing: subtract.

🏠 Menu

🪁 Kite in a tree

Your kite is stuck in a tree. You hold 13 m of string, standing 5 m from the trunk.

How high up the tree is your kite?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

String = hypotenuse

13² − 5²

Step 2

169 − 25 = 144

√144 = 12 m

12 m up. Bye bye, kite! 🪁
